subject: Post-call: Novus Health — leadership summary, risks & procurement path
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@novushealth.com>, Novus Health Procurement <procurement@novushealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-14T16:12:00-08:00
Subject: Post-call: Novus Health — leadership summary, risks & procurement path

Hi Elena / Novus team,

Thanks for your time on today's call. Below is a concise recap for your execs and procurement to digest — focused on business outcomes, key risks, and the procurement path we discussed.

Business outcomes & success metrics
- Primary goal: move inference for clinical summarization pipeline from on-prem CPU to hosted GPU to reduce median latency from ~600ms to <150ms per request.
- Cost target: reduce inference cost per 1M tokens by ~30–40% vs current self-hosted baseline.
- Availability: target 99.95% inference availability for peak hours (ET business day).

Primary pain points
- High tail latency during batch processing windows impacting clinician UX.
- Unpredictable unit costs and maintenance overhead for GPU ops.
- Strict data residency & audit requirements for patient data (onshore storage + audit trail).

Security/compliance asks (from Novus)
- SOC 2 Type II attestation and evidence of network isolation (VPC option).
- KMS integration options (bring-your-own-key) + audit logs retention policy.

Procurement path & timeline
- Exec sponsor: Elena Ruiz (confirmed).
- Procurement contact: procurement@novushealth.com (we'll engage legal/procurement for SOW/PO).
- Target timeline: pilot PO to be issued within 3–4 weeks pending SOC2 evidence and final SOW.

Blockers & escalations
- Data residency proof & KMS details are blockers for approval.
- If legal review extends beyond 30 days we should escalate to Marcus for exec facilitation.

Agreed next steps (owner — due date)
- Vanessa: send Mutual Action Plan and draft SOW (attached) — today (Feb 14).
- SE + Security (Redwood): schedule technical deep-dive on KMS and VPC — propose Feb 18 (Vanessa to coordinate).
- Novus Procurement: provide PO template and procurement timeline — request by Feb 17 (Elena/Luis).

Attachments
- [Attachment: Novus_Mutual_Action_Plan_20270214.xlsx (xlsx, 52KB)]
- [Attachment: SOW_draft_v1.pdf (pdf, 48KB)]

If I've mischaracterized anything, please flag. Otherwise I'll move forward with the attachments and calendar invites.

Thanks,

Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0122
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@novushealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Novus Health Procurement <procurement@novushealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-14T17:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Novus Health — leadership summary, risks & procurement path

Vanessa — thanks for the clear recap.

Confirming the high-level outcomes and risks above. Adding a couple of notes from our side:
- I'll loop in our procurement lead, Luis Moreno (luis.moreno@novushealth.com) — Luis will own the PO/SOW path.
- Budget window: we have discretionary funds in Q1 but need approvals by March 10 to hit the pilot start.
- Can you provide: SOC 2 Type II report (redacted), data retention policy with retention windows, and a short KMS integration one-pager? Those documents will speed legal review.

Luis — can you share your standard PO template and any shipping steps for vendor onboarding?

Happy to proceed with the Feb 18 technical deep-dive. Please send calendar options.

Best,

Elena Ruiz
VP, Digital Transformation | Novus Health
elena.ruiz@novushealth.com
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>

Date: 2027-02-14T18:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Novus Health — leadership summary, risks & procurement path

Team — quick internal note.
- Vanessa: good recap. Please prioritize the SOC2 pack and a one-page KMS summary for Elena.
- Approved: up to 10% pilot discount to help de-risk initial adoption (mark in the SOW). If procurement pushes for >30% total concession, escalate to me.
- If legal requests custom data residency controls beyond our VPC offering, loop in Product Security (cc Grace) — we can propose a private deployment for the pilot but that'll change timeline.

I'll review the SOW and comment by EOD tomorrow.

-Marcus
VP Sales, Redwood Inference
